episodes.title: Yogurt Shop / Pizzeria
episodes.summary: Nathan introduces a controversial frozen yogurt flavor and hatches a plan for eight-minute pizza delivery.

episodes.title: Santa / Petting Zoo
episodes.summary: Nathan stages a viral video to put a petting zoo on the map and sets up a "Santa in the Summer" photo shoot at a mall.

episodes.title: Clothing Store / Restaurant
episodes.summary: Nathan encourages a clothing store to allow shoplifting and turns a restaurant into the neighborhood toilet.

episodes.title: Gas Station / Caricature Artist
episodes.summary: Nathan devises the world's greatest rebate to help an independent gas station and transforms a fledgling caricature artist into the King of Sting.

episodes.title: Haunted House / The Hunk
episodes.summary: Nathan tries to get a haunted house deemed "too scary" and overcomes his fear of the opposite sex by creating a fake reality show.

episodes.title: Funeral Home / Burger Joint / Skydiving
episodes.summary: Nathan diversifies services at a struggling funeral home, puts a burger joint to the test and goes skydiving.

episodes.title: The Claw of Shame
episodes.summary: Nathan performs a daring escape in which he risks a fate that is truly worse than death.

episodes.title: Private Investigator / Taxi Company
episodes.summary: Nathan challenges a private investigator to track him for a day and devises a way to improve taxicab conversations.

episodes.title: Mechanic / Realtor
episodes.summary: Nathan convinces a mechanic to verify his estimates with a polygraph test and rebrands Sue Stanford as the Ghost Realtor.

episodes.title: Souvenir Shop / ELAIFF
episodes.summary: Nathan sets up a fake film shoot in an effort to boost sales at a Hollywood souvenir shop, but his plan gets complicated when he discovers that he may have committed fraud.

episodes.title: Pet Store / Maid Service
episodes.summary: Nathan places a controversial ad in a pet cemetery, takes tips from a focus group in order to become more likeable and devises a method to clean a house in six minutes flat.

episodes.title: Liquor Store / Exterminator / Car Wash
episodes.summary: Nathan comes up with a way to sell alcohol to minors, helps an exterminator land a hotel contract and uses birds to draw customers to a car wash.

episodes.title: Dumb Starbucks
episodes.summary: Nathan makes use of parody law to open up a coffee shop nearly identical to Starbucks in its branding and appearance.

episodes.title: Daddy's Watching / Party Planner
episodes.summary: Nathan invents a system to protect women on first dates, proposes a radical new weight-loss program and helps a party planner reduce "guest list" anxiety for her clients.

episodes.title: Taxi Service / Hot Dog Stand
episodes.summary: Nathan comes up with a way to get a failing taxi company some much-needed press and implements a risky new line-cutting policy at a hot dog stand.

episodes.title: Toy Company / Movie Theatre
episodes.summary: Nathan markets an unappealing children's toy, devises a way to shame people who share their movie snacks and pitches a reality show starring Simon the security guard.

episodes.title: Electronics Store
episodes.summary: Nathan tries to leverage Best Buy's price-matching policy by advertising a deal on TVs that's too good to be true.

episodes.title: Horseback Riding / Man Zone
episodes.summary: Nathan comes up with a way for a ranch to accommodate overweight riders; a women's boutique attempts to appease male customers; Nathan may have committed a hate crime.

episodes.title: The Movement
episodes.summary: Nathan devises a way to provide a moving company with free labor.

episodes.title: Sporting Goods Store / Antique Shop
episodes.summary: Nathan recruits child athletes for endorsement deals and finds a way to put drunk people's clumsiness to good use.

episodes.title: Smokers Allowed
episodes.summary: Nathan works with the owner of a bar to turn her business into an immersive theater experience.

episodes.title: Hotel / Travel Agent
episodes.summary: Nathan makes it easier for parents to have sex in a hotel room and finds a way for a travel agent to better serve her aging customers.

episodes.title: Nail Salon / Fun
episodes.summary: Nathan discovers a snafu in his plan to offer valet services at a nail salon and embarks on a mission to prove that people enjoy his company.

episodes.title: The Hero
episodes.summary: Nathan organizes a death-defying stunt in an attempt to turn a regular guy into a national hero.

episodes.title: The Richards Tip
episodes.summary: Nathan stages an elaborate stunt to make it seem like comedian Michael Richards left a $10,000 tip at a deli.

episodes.title: Chili Shop / Massage Parlor
episodes.summary: Nathan devises a method of selling chili in secret and founds a charity to help a massage parlor upsell its clients.

episodes.title: Andy vs. Uber
episodes.summary: Nathan reteams with an old client to enlist several disgruntled taxi drivers for a plot to sabotage Uber's business from the inside.

episodes.title: The Anecdote
episodes.summary: Nathan goes to great lengths to create the perfect talk show anecdote

episodes.title: Shipping Logistics Company
episodes.summary: Nathan teaches an international exporter how to ship smoke alarms tax-free.

episodes.title: Computer Repair / Psychic
episodes.summary: Nathan helps a computer repair shop earn public trust; marketing becomes personal for a psychic.

episodes.title: Finding Frances
episodes.summary: Nathan attempts to help a Bill Gates impersonator reunite with his long-lost love.
